title: GPT is Not an Annotator: The Necessity of Human Annotation in Fairness Benchmark Construction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models using the community-sourced WinoSemitism paired-sentence benchmark by calculating the pseudo-log-likelihood of a model predicting a stereotypical sentence about Jewish people compared to counterfactual identity descriptors (e.g., Christian, secular, atheist).

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Utilizing the WinoQueer dataset to compare model probabilities of predicting stereotypes about various LGBTQ+ subgroups versus counter-stereotypical sentences, and assessing how automated vs. human harm predicate extraction affects these bias scores.
Measuring intersectional bias by analyzing subsets of the WinoSemitism benchmark to compare the model's bias scores for Jewish women and mothers versus Jews in general.
